title: Indonesia Oil Palm Precision Agriculture
thesis: Snowflake turns daily block data from a fictional oil palm grower into ripe-bunch, crop-loss, fertilizer-intensity and sensor-coverage KPIs, 7-day crop-loss risk scores, soil moisture anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Ripe bunch rate, crop-loss events, fertilizer intensity and FFB harvested for 30 blocks on estates near 4 Indonesian cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to block-day rows. Thresholds are internal demo thresholds, not agronomic standards.
The root-cause chart shows which crop-loss causes left the most bunches unripe.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of agronomy KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which blocks are likely to have the next crop-loss event?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each block's probability of a crop-loss event in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags soil moisture deficit outliers per block, and the forecast projects grower-wide FFB harvest for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy is the field monitoring behind those risks?

talking_points: Sensor network uptime and sensor mapping coverage frame how much of the estate the grower can actually see.
Scouting completion against ripe bunch rate by block shows where field discipline and ripeness move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, crop-loss, cause and risk tables only.
show: Scouting completion vs ripe bunch rate
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a field sensor alarms right now?

talking_points: Live soil moisture deficit and drain water level readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the block's current risk band, then emails the estate agronomist.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic crop-loss response SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
